references.title: Meadows roadside
references.observation: Rooted oak, layered grass, worn path and clustered household clutter. Keep the path broad and quiet.

references.title: Neighborhood street
references.observation: Kerbs, driveways, stoops and garden pockets give the suburb structure. Preserve the clear street through the detail.

references.title: Frontier overview
references.observation: Landmarks and atmosphere connect the regions. Use for orientation and mood; this view does not set the gameplay camera.

references.title: Silver civic plaza
references.observation: Silver geometry, glass and worn paving around a strong landmark. Reduce decorative emission near gameplay cues.

references.title: City intersection
references.observation: Crosswalks, kerbs and building setbacks create readable urban routes. Signs follow the approved ecosystem data file.

references.title: Closing Bell court
references.observation: Ceremonial entrance, substantial architecture and a quiet central floor. Architecture is reference material, not an approved arena layout.

references.title: Cliffside homes
references.observation: White concrete, glass, palms and rock strata. Water edges and terraces must agree with authored collision and elevation.

references.title: Beach and pier
references.observation: Weathered planks, beach clutter, shallow-water depth and restrained foam. Avoid bright pickup-like glows in the surf.

references.title: Lighthouse path
references.observation: A distant landmark anchors the coastal route. Borrow silhouette and atmosphere rather than changing the runtime camera.

references.title: Cypress boardwalk
references.observation: Rooted cypress, reeds, stilt buildings and damp timber. Boardwalk edges stay visible beneath mist.

references.title: Barn and windmill
references.observation: Red timber barns, silos, crop fences and wheel ruts. Cluster props against the buildings and leave open field routes.

references.title: Crop lanes
references.observation: Crop-row rhythm, a stone culvert and a broad dirt track. Corn is a boundary only where the map actually defines one.

references.title: Storm over the farm
references.observation: Storm palette and low sky are mood reference only. Lightning is subject to flash limits and reduced motion.

references.title: Lock approach
references.observation: Gates, winches, channels and landing platforms make the objective a place. This image does not authorize new objective rules.

references.title: Lockkeeper clearing
references.observation: Quiet central floor, strong water boundary and gates at the far edge. Preserve approach and escape routes in the greybox.

references.title: Lantern grove
references.observation: Dead-tree silhouettes, cool fog and small lantern pools. Darkness must not conceal actors or navigation cues.

references.title: Cemetery chapel
references.observation: Graves and a chapel form distinct clusters beside a clear path. Keep silhouettes human or zombie and readable.

references.title: Cemetery mood
references.observation: Moonlight, wet ground and layered dead trees. Ground-level perspective is atmosphere reference, not a camera proposal.

references.title: Ridge switchbacks
references.observation: Rock strata, retaining edges and sparse pines express height. Drops and climbs remain disabled until their own gameplay slice.

references.title: Quarry crossing
references.observation: Rope bridge, quarry terraces and machinery establish destination and scale. Test collision-to-art alignment at every edge.

references.title: Mountain landmark
references.observation: Distant architecture and light shafts establish scale. Preserve the current top-down input projection.

references.title: Fortress gate
references.observation: Masonry, gatehouse and rampart silhouettes convey control of the route. Actor canon remains human survivors and zombies.

references.title: Fortress courtyard
references.observation: Substantial perimeter, ramps and storage clusters frame a quiet combat floor. This is a staging study, not approved topology.

references.title: Forge arena
references.observation: Industrial mass and a quiet center support the Foreman. Tone down orange decorative heat so real attack cues own the bright warm range.

references.title: River crossings
references.observation: Stone and plank bridges, pine roots and rocky banks give crossings distinct identities. Water boundaries must match the map.

references.title: Waterfall ledge
references.observation: Readable depth, rock shelves and restrained foam. Fine caustics yield before frame rate when quality lowers.

references.title: Baron's clearing
references.observation: Theatrical cloth and perimeter props frame a broad stage. De-emphasize floor stripes underneath attack telegraphs.

references.title: Roadside fuel stop
references.observation: Cracked asphalt, utility buildings and clustered service clutter make travel feel inhabited.

references.title: Surface junction
references.observation: Road materials and signposts make transitions legible. Area connections still require greybox checks and owner playtest.

references.title: Forest track
references.observation: Root flares, worn wheel tracks and leaf litter support a readable forest route. Camps need their own accepted briefs.

references.title: Evening service yard
references.observation: Fuel-stop silhouette, worn canopy and service props are useful. Decorative neon cannot compete with interactive cues.

references.title: Mill and ford
references.observation: Stone banks, willow clusters and a mill landmark. A visual ford never creates a traversable surface by itself.

references.title: Utility landmark
references.observation: Service access, fenced equipment and power infrastructure give roads purpose. Equipment is scenery, not an actor proxy.

references.title: Quarry camp
references.observation: Mining equipment, shelters and stone piles form perimeter clusters. Keep a navigable route between them.

references.title: Connected-world sketch
references.observation: Useful overview of landmark hierarchy and regional variation. Do not import its geography, roads or camera as an approved gameplay map.
